item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day's got structure — meditation, walking the dogs, picking up the kids, an evening event. Easy to run on autopilot and forget water while you're managing all of it. Keep a bottle within reach and finish it before you pick up the paycheck this afternoon. Action: drink a full glass of water right now, before anything else on the list.
